title: A Trustworthiness Score to Evaluate DNN Predictions
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion. The key findings are that the proposed trustworthiness score (TS) improves the precision of trustworthy predictions by ~20% and helps in detecting suspicious frames (with false negatives) with ~5% improvement compared to relying on the model's confidence score alone.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It introduces a 'trustworthiness score' (TS) to evaluate the predictions of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) in object detection tasks.
